applications.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
applications.description: Central authentication portal for all company services.

applications.name: Leave & Attendance Portal
applications.description: Employee portal for marking daily attendance and applying for leaves.

applications.name: Oracle ERP Data Cluster
applications.description: Main database backend handling finance and enterprise resource planning.

applications.name: IT Service Desk Portal
applications.description: Ticketing system for raising IT and admin requests.

applications.name: VPN Gateway
applications.description: Virtual Private Network gateway for remote access to company resources.

applications.name: Corporate Intranet
applications.description: Internal company knowledge base and news portal.

applications.name: Payroll System
applications.description: Employee portal for viewing salary slips and tax deductions.

application_purposes.purpose_text: Used to login to applications. Verifies passwords, handles multi-factor authentication (MFA), and user access tokens.
Used by employees to mark morning attendance, view holiday calendars, and request sick or annual leave.
Core database that stores employee salaries, vendor payments, and supply chain records.
Used to send and receive emails internally and externally, manage calendars, and schedule meetings.
Used to create IT support tickets, request new hardware, and report software issues.
Allows remote employees to securely connect to the internal company network from outside the office.
Central hub for company policies, announcements, directory, and shared documentation.
Generates monthly payslips, handles tax declaration forms, and manages employee compensation details.

application_symptoms.symptom_text: I forgot my password. My account is locked out. MFA code is not arriving on my phone. Invalid credentials error.
Password reset link nahi aaya. Account block ho gaya hai. OTP nahi aa raha.
Unable to mark attendance today. The leave portal page is blank. My leave balance is showing negative. Cannot submit leave request.
Attendance mark nahi ho raha. Leave apply page stuck ho gaya. Chutti ka balance galat dikha raha hai.
ERP queries are timing out. The finance module is very slow. Oracle database connection refused. Data sync failure.
Not receiving any new emails. Outlook is disconnected from server. Cannot attach large files to email. Mailbox is full.
Cannot submit a new ticket. The service desk portal is down. I am getting an error when requesting a new laptop.
VPN keeps disconnecting. Cisco AnyConnect is failing to connect. Remote desktop is very laggy over VPN.
Ghar se VPN connect nahi ho raha. Baar baar disconnect ho raha hai.
Intranet page is not loading. Cannot find the HR policy document. Search function on the intranet is broken.
Payslip is not generating. My tax declaration was not saved. Incorrect salary credited.
Salary slip download nahi ho raha hai. Tax ka amount galat hai.

application_dependencies.description: Leave portal requires SSO for user login.
Leave portal stores and retrieves employee records from the Oracle ERP database.
Webmail uses SSO for authenticating users into their inboxes.
IT Service Desk uses SSO for authentication.
Payroll System requires SSO for secure access.
Payroll fetches employee salary structure from Oracle ERP.
Corporate Intranet requires VPN connection when accessed remotely.
